{{Quote|For your dining pleasure this evening, gentlemen and ladies, I have produced a crisp caramaxoian salad with Dihneral herb-and-ale dressing.|434-FPC|<ref name="Galladinium" />}}
'''Dihneral herb-and-ale dressing''' was a type of [[Dressing/Legends|dressing]]<ref name="Galladinium" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Dihneral system/Legends|Dihneral system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[434-FPC Personal Chef Droid]] [[434-FPC]] [[Chef/Legends|prepared]] a [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]] for several people. For the initial course, the [[Cooking droid/Legends|droid]] made [[caramaxoian salad]] paired with Dihneral [[Plant/Legends|herb]]-and-[[Ale/Legends|ale]] dressing.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dihneral herb-and-ale dressing was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
